articles.title: 'AI trade never died': Traders see room for market recovery, but bitcoin's participation is another story
articles.snippet: Monday's tech enthusiasm is quickly fading on Tuesday, while bitcoin remains near bear-market lows.

articles.title: South Korea proposes ending 2017 ICO ban to boost jobs and onshore crypto investment
articles.snippet: Token issuers would have to disclose how they plan to spend investors' money and could face criminal charges for misleading buyers.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs near $5B in record monthly outflows amid AI stock rout
articles.snippet: US spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded $4.94 billion in November net outflows, exceeding the previous monthly record of $4.51 billion set in June.

articles.title: Solana DEX Velocity halts trading over bug just months after relaunch
articles.snippet: Velocity relaunched in September as a rebuilt version of Drift Protocol, which was attacked by North Korean hackers in April.

articles.title: BlackRock launches tokenized money market fund accepting stablecoins in Hong Kong
articles.snippet: The tokenized fund launched with approximately $100 million in assets, with Standard Chartered and Ant International participating as seed investors.
